reason: I already give free meals to creators and have no idea if anyone walks in because of them, so a free tool that shows customers per creator is worth two minutes of sign-up. If it doesn't work I've lost nothing, and the ₹200 a month is just a bonus.
objection: My staff won't remember to ask for the coupon or punch in a PIN at lunch rush, so the counter will show zero and I'll be no wiser than I am now.
